verdict.reason: The root package mixes settled primitives (span, layout, identity) with evolving policy every package imports: config.py and dispatch.py changed in 14 and 11 of the last 40 commits.
A config record: for_rule reads rules and excludes reads exclude and anchor, two lookups over one loaded configuration.
The efferent and afferent maps are the two directions of one dependency graph built from the same edges; splitting them would duplicate the graph.
A fixed exchange contract: documents, residue, ruling and verdict shapes under SCHEMA_VERSION, which other packages are written against and change only as a deliberate versioned event.
One token-space: slice rebuilds a narrower Lexicon from the same units and stop words the counts were made from.
A value object: defined reads the definition and labels reads the label fields of one SKOS term.
term, preferred and words read the label index built from terms in __init__, which defined and narrower read directly; one scheme.
The test restates the plan's sort key to check its order; a one-line key, not a shared design.
An abstract template: subclasses supply zone and in_zone, and describe formats the same package view measure reads.
nested reads children through the inherited _children_of, which LCOM4 does not count; kind and nested describe one carved callable.
realms reads inherited children and dependency_graph the shared context; both are views of the one carved corpus.
methods and nested_classes read inherited children, properties and bases read carve results; all describe one carved class node.
